A [[Gender|female]] individual was the '''wife''' of [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Lonni Jung]]. Following [[Lonni Jung's daughter|her daughter's]] birth at some point between [[6 BBY]] and [[5 BBY]], her husband wished to resign as an [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] [[officer]] and [[spy]] for [[Luthen Rael]] to instead work at her [[Lonni Jung's wife's family|family]]'s [[Unidentified import business|import business]], but Rael pointed out to him that the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] would not let him go.<ref name="One Way Out" />
